name: Gemini
summary: Google's AI assistant app powered by Gemini models.
description: Update replacing 'Gemini 1.5 Pro': Gemini is now Google's AI assistant and model family (latest Gemini 4 Argon) for chat, Deep Research, image and video creation and Gemini Live, integrated across Google apps. The app is free with a Google account; Google AI Plus costs $4.99/month, Pro $19.99/month and Ultra from $99.99/month, while developers access the models through Google AI Studio and the Gemini API.

pricing.label: Freemium

features: Multilingual Support: Translates and understands content across languages.
Accurate Summarization: Extracts key ideas from long documents.
Factual Consistency: Prioritizes fact-checking and evidence-backed output.
Academic Writing: Generates citations, structured arguments, and reports.
